title: Cannot add Wireguard VPN connection when adding IPs without CIDR prefix
line: WireGuard peers now accept a plain address like 192.168.0.1 in Allowed IPs, treated as a single host.
explanation: The peer editor validated the whole Allowed IPs list with SimpleIpListValidator(WithCidr), whose IPv4/IPv6 patterns require a /prefix. A plain address therefore stayed Intermediate, the field turned red and OK stayed disabled with no message, although wg-quick and NetworkManager accept a plain address as a single host. The change checks each comma-separated entry and accepts it either with a prefix or as a plain address; the stored list is unchanged.

commits.message:
wireguard: accept allowed IPs without a prefix length

A peer's Allowed IPs only accepted addresses with a CIDR prefix, so a
plain address like 192.168.0.1 kept the field red and OK disabled. Treat
it as a single host, like wg-quick and NetworkManager already do.

BUG: 452491

media.caption: Before: Allowed IPs '192.168.0.1' is red and OK is disabled (sweep tester, same master build)
After: '192.168.0.1' is accepted and OK is enabled
After: incomplete '192.168.0.', a trailing comma and '/33' are still rejected; a mixed list of plain and prefixed IPv4/IPv6 entries and '/32' are accepted

review.text: Accepting plain IPv4/IPv6 host addresses without a CIDR prefix in WireGuard peer Allowed IPs matches the bug report and wg-quick/NetworkManager expectations. However, adding a second file-scope static SimpleIpListValidator introduces another global static QObject lifetime hazard and redundantly runs two list validators inside a manual comma-split loop instead of extending SimpleIpListValidator (with unit tests) or using local single-address validators. Saving/validating an unprefixed entry with NetworkManager was also never exercised, even offline.
changes: Avoid adding a file-scope static QObject validator and redundant list-in-loop validation: either add an optional-CIDR mode to SimpleIpListValidator with unit tests in simpleiplisttest, or validate split items using function-local SimpleIpV4AddressValidator/SimpleIpV6AddressValidator instances.
Verify that NetworkManager actually accepts an unprefixed allowed-ips entry over D-Bus/libnm (e.g., via nmcli --offline or a test against dbusmock/libnm) without rejecting the saved connection.
Consider updating the Allowed IPs field tooltip on master so it no longer implies CIDR prefixes are strictly required.

reviews.text: Fixes exactly what was reported: a bare address in a WireGuard peer's Allowed IPs is now accepted as a single host, which matches wg-quick and libnm's 'address with optional prefix' semantics, and the stored list is unchanged. Validating each trimmed entry against the existing WithCidr and Base list validators mirrors how the endpoint field already ORs validators, and the after shots show incomplete addresses, trailing commas and /33 still rejected while mixed IPv4/IPv6 lists pass. Only nit: the field's tooltip still says 'with CIDR masks', which is now slightly inaccurate.
